notes.title: Minimalist casual puzzle game "Arrive in Time" is now officially released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Hade.

My personal indie game "Arrive in Time" is now available, with a 10% discount for the first two weeks!

The game supports Windows and Mac OS systems.

It can be played with both keyboard/mouse and game controllers.

This is a puzzle game that requires thinking - but there are no penalties for failure, and you can restart at any time.

Feel free to add the game to your cart or wishlist!

Hade will continue to bring you more games with innovative gameplay.

Thank you all!
